reviews.quote: this big-screen convertible laptop certainly has some positives but there are a few too many minuses to give this Plus a full-throated recommendation.

praises: 2TB of NVMe at $1,768 on a 16" touch convertible — storage-per-dollar standout
Fast single-core Lunar Lake performance for office work
Full numpad and big touch panel
Arc 140V fine for casual gaming and light creative work
complaints: Class-worst battery in its category (~7h real world)
Mushy keyboard; spacebar reliability complaints echoed from pro review
RAM soldered at 16GB regardless of storage tier

design_philosophy: The storage-max variant of the CA retail 16 Plus 2-in-1: Dell's CA channel loads the base IPS chassis with 2TB (and even 4TB) SSDs for buyers who want capacity over display quality, keeping the same Lunar Lake platform and compromises throughout.
rating_notes: Identical to entry 39 (1TB IPS) plus +999GB storage; +0.0 ratings, storage alone doesn't move factors except creative_work marginally. Inferred from CNET DB06250 anchor per SHARED-dell-2in1.md.
